content.content: Error: Garmin login missing or expired. This server cannot read Garmin data until its owner makes a new Personal API key in Garmin Connect and sets it on the server. Retrying will not help until then.

content.text:
I can't tell you how you are today, because I couldn't get to your Garmin data. The server says its Garmin login is missing or has expired, so it can't read anything from your account right now.

**How to fix it:** The server owner needs to create a new Personal API key in Garmin Connect and add it to the server. If that's you, do that and then ask me again. Trying again before then won't work, and the other data sources (sleep, HRV, Body Battery) use the same login, so they'll fail too.

Once it's reconnected, I can check last night's sleep, HRV and resting heart rate against your 7-day averages, plus your training load, and tell you whether today looks like a day to push or to take it easy.
